sentences.ar: بالضيعة، كانت في ست كبيرة الكل يحترمها.
sentences.en: In the village, there was an old lady everyone respected.

sentences.en: They called her Hajjeh Um Yusuf.

sentences.en: When a problem arose, people would go to consult her.

sentences.en: Once, two neighbors argued over the boundary of the land.

sentences.ar: الحجة سمعتهم، وبعدين سألت سؤال بسيط.

The two neighbors looked at each other, and felt ashamed.

sentences.en: They returned to their homes, their hearts clear.
